patchSeriesFailingTest: cross-platform file request produces a clean probe terminal record (collector-process.spec.cjs:66)
rootCause: Windows fs.renameSync over an existing destination intermittently returns EPERM when another process holds the target open (parent pollers, guard, probe verifier all read heartbeat.json/collector-result.json while the writer runs). No-concurrent-reader baseline reproduced 0/400 failures; with a 5ms concurrent reader 11-25/400 failures, all EPERM on rename.
change: Retry the tmp->target swap with bounded backoff (6 attempts, 20-120ms) on EPERM/EACCES/EBUSY; if the swap stays blocked, overwrite the target in place instead of losing the evidence. tmp cleanup is now also failure-tolerant.
scope: external observation tooling only; candidate source, guard semantics, upload gating and restore conditions unchanged
